I'll report back on when I find the root cause. It could also be a problem with mocha itself. I haven't tried to reproduce again (since September) and it's possible maybe this is already fixed...
Can confirm, this is still a bug.
What's even weirder about this bug is that it only happens when running `cypress run` and it only happens if both of the errors have no arguments. Passing `throw new Error('foo')` works.

Figured out the error part - this is actually a problem with the reporter.

When there are no commands in a test AND no properties change the reporter will not update, and Cypress will hang forever.

Because the error messages were the same (an empty string) `""`, and the test was already `isOpen` due to not having any commands - it would never update.

The fundamental problem about this isn't about errors - it's about state. When a test has its state updated and no properties actually change (due to a perfect storm of problems) - the reporter will never update the UI, and Cypress will never take a screenshot and continue on. That's the area it's failing at.
